content.text: This is a short post to let you know that the 2026 Capital Grants offer is now open for applications.
Before starting an application, please read the applicant’s guide.
The applicant’s guide sets out:
Submitting a complete application with all the required supporting information will help avoid delays and ensure your application can be assessed as quickly as possible.
You should also make sure that:
Watch webinar
To help you prepare, we hosted a webinar earlier today.
During the session, our team was joined by colleagues from the RPA and CSF.
We explained which grant items may require CSF advice before you apply, while RPA colleagues talked through the application and claims process.
The webinar concluded with a Q&A session, giving attendees the opportunity to put their questions directly to the team.
Watch the recording
Catchment Sensitive Farming support

Some Capital Grant items require support from CSF before you can apply. (These items are listed in Table 1 of Annex 2) and need an advisory consultation to discuss the environmental priorities for your land.
CSF teams are currently unable to prioritise new requests for advisory visits, but they expect to offer more visits later this year.
You can use the CSF advice request form to register your interest, and a member of the team will contact you when they have capacity to help.
In the meantime, you can register for one of their free events. If you've received CSF support for the relevant items dated from 1 July 2024, you can use this when applying.
The RPA will remove any capital items from your application if they do not have CSF support.
Subscribe to the Farming Blog
The 2026 application window will close when all the available funding has been allocated. We will publish posts when 25%, 50% and 75% of the available funding has been allocated.
Subscribe to the Farming Blog to stay up to date with Capital Grants and other farming schemes.
You'll receive an email notification whenever a new post is published, including updates on policy developments, funding opportunities and ways to get involved.
